product: RouteIQ (AI route and fuel optimization for freight fleets)

stakeholders.name: Meera Kapoor
stakeholders.stance: Champion. Wants fuel and idle-time savings, prefers short updates over long decks.

stakeholders.name: Arjun Rao
stakeholders.stance: Economic Buyer. Price-sensitive, skeptical of discounts, responds to ROI built on Northwind's own data.

stakeholders.name: Dev Malhotra
stakeholders.stance: Evaluator. Blocks approval until ISO 27001 audit evidence and data residency answers are delivered.

past_deals.lesson: CFO approved after a one-page ROI sheet built from Apex's own fuel-cost data. A discount request was declined and the deal still closed.
The security questionnaire was sent in week 6, so IT blocked the deal and the champion lost momentum. Competitor FleetLogic won on faster onboarding.
A 3-year term with a price lock beat a straight discount. The champion preferred short Slack updates over slide decks.

interactions.notes: Meera said fuel optimization and idle time are the top priorities across the 420-truck fleet. They run SAP TM. Mentioned they are also evaluating FleetLogic.
Meera asked for a summary of two slides maximum. Said long decks never get read internally.
Demo went well. Arjun joined late and objected to the $84k annual price versus a FleetLogic quote of about $70k. Strongly opposed to upfront discounts being used as a closing tactic.
Sent a generic pricing deck to Arjun. No reply in five days.
Dev asked for the ISO 27001 audit report and details on data residency, specifically whether fleet telemetry stays in-region. Alex promised both by Friday and missed the deadline.
Meera confirmed SAP TM integration is a hard requirement. FleetLogic is claiming a two-week onboarding.
Arjun replied to a one-page ROI sheet built from Northwind's own fuel spend. He asked about contract length options instead of discounts.
Dev received the ISO 27001 audit report but is still waiting on the data residency answer. Meera wants a final pricing proposal before quarter end.
